nodes.name: Webhook: Invoice Upload
nodes.notes: Operator-facing entry point. Real binary upload, multipart/form-data. Uses a production Webhook rather than a Form Trigger: the Form Trigger's production endpoint requires the same workflow-activation step this webhook already needs, but offers no advantage for headless/curl-based verification, which this demo's test suite relies on throughout (matching the project's existing PR #5 verification style). A minimal local HTML upload page (examples/n8n/phase1_upload_demo_page.html) POSTs here for the browser demo.

nodes.name: Human Review - Standard
nodes.notes: Phase 1 ends here: routed for standard-priority human review. No automated approval, booking, payment, or supplier communication.

nodes.name: Human Review - Prioritized
nodes.notes: Phase 1 ends here: routed for prioritized human review (klaerung_erforderlich, or a nicht_pruefbar content finding from the API itself). No automated approval, booking, payment, or supplier communication.

nodes.name: Human Review - Technical
nodes.notes: Explicit technical-failure route -- does not depend on the unknown-value fallback. Reached when a service was unreachable after bounded retry, a required capability was absent, or an unexpected API error status was returned. No automated approval, booking, payment, or supplier communication.

nodes.name: Human Review - Unknown (fallback)
nodes.notes: Safety fallback for a routing value that matches none of the explicit routes above -- kept separate from Human Review - Technical so an expected technical failure is never silently absorbed into a generic "unknown" bucket. Never silently ignored.
